verdict.rationale: The only privacy control in evidence is Cursor's Privacy Mode, which promises only that 'we will not train on your data'. That is an opt-out from model training, an adjacent control, not an opt-out from telemetry or usage tracking. No evidence shows Bugbot lets users disable telemetry, analytics or usage tracking.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
